mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Experimental Ethernet sharing of hub USB libraries over PRO DJ LINK.
mods.description: Browse and load USB sticks connected through a hub, with experimental Ethernet sharing over PRO DJ LINK. One physical hub stick passed independent software-client discovery, complete3172-track library browsing and exact whole database/MP3 downloads, including after native Link Off/On. Native USB access remains available. Four local decks Off; two local decks On. HUB labels and individual/whole-hub safe eject are retained; wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. External players handle source loss according to their cache. Actual-CDJ interoperability, Wi-Fi sharing, phase alignment, eight-source hardware, long-session timing and cache capacity remain unvalidated. One emulator recovery run failed EOF/STALE; two full repeats passed, original cause unresolved. Exact firmware2.00 ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel4.4.194 and core>=1.2.3. Includes GPL kernel modules. AZ-MODS stages files internally. Immutable package retains its tested candidate wording; see release notes for current validation.
